name: Rasterizer
responsibility: Admits one job at a time, starts a browser only when there is work, and retires one that failed a capture
description: Nothing is started until a job arrives, and the session is stopped with the rasterizer, so no browser outlives the command that needed it. A Chromium that failed one capture is closed rather than trusted with the next.
